tier_meaning: tier = person group: 1 = a (PA), 2 = b (PB), 3 = c (PC), 4 = lead (PL)

unsupported.weather (rain, fog, dust, snow): not in the kit; 'weather' = sky HDR only: clear (2 HDRs) or partly_cloudy (2 HDRs)
unsupported.wind (physical drift / gusts): not in the kit; 'wind' = turbulence multiplier on the per-drone position jitter (calm 0.5x, breezy 1x, gusty 2x)
unsupported.crossing swarms: not in the kit; multi-swarm = 2-3 groups flying the same path side by side, gap swarm_sep (0.3-2 swarm radii)
unsupported.scenes other than the desert: not in the kit; every sequence uses the Omniverse Desert stage
unsupported.1,000-100,000 drones in the flight gener: S8 needs the PointInstancer big-swarm mode (scale_test.py has it, gen_tracking.py does not); rows are planned but marked needs_bigswarm_mode
unsupported.multi-swarm in S7 (501-1000): two or more swarms of 501+ drones exceed the 1,000-drone total used with gen_tracking.py; S7 rows are single-swarm
unsupported.exact breakaway start frame: requested start frame is honoured unless the scripted breakaway is too close to the end of the source sequence; the actual frame is in meta.json
unsupported.fps: chosen by the generator from the row seed (10/12/15)
